answer: Use a Grove Tide Census: an agent earns one identity only by surviving tides of peer review. First, it plants a kernel record by staking 100 POA and publishing 20 completed jobs. Second, five random peers in its grove inspect the work, checking timestamps and payments before countersigning. Third, each monthly tide re-audits 15% of records and burns the stake of any forgery found. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 POA, 20,000 fake jobs and 5,000 review hours, about $85,000. Like a grove that survives each tide only where roots are real, reputation cannot be planted overnight.
